subject: Mobile Development
title: The Motorola DynaTAC 8000X
description: Learn The Motorola DynaTAC 8000X in one minute.

hook.text: In 1983, the first commercial mobile phone hit stores. It cost $3,995.

buildup.text: The Motorola DynaTAC was 33 centimeters tall and earned the nickname 'The Brick.'

discovery.text: It offered 30 minutes of talk time and took 10 hours to fully charge.

twist.text: Despite the price, there was a waitlist. Status-seekers and executives lined up.

climax.text: The DynaTAC proved that people would pay almost anything to make calls on the go.

punchline.text: The first mobile phone cost more than a used car.

quiz.question: How much did the Motorola DynaTAC cost at launch?
